content.text: I'll investigate the history of these four files to find when the `Biweekly.write(ical).go()` pattern (without timezone info) was introduced.

content.content:
8c8ca2c5 Calendar servlet  - fixed a potential NullPointerException
507166e9 Spring Security  - events pages (both old and new) changed to use the new security model
0a17f6c0 Merge of recent changes from dev_events branch to trunk:
23388194 Spring Security  - Examination Timetabling pages and a few other pages (Buildings, Date Patterns, Data Exchange, and Roll Forward) changed to use the new security model  - code cleanup of the related classes (e.g., marking @Deprecated methods that need to be avoided or rewritten)
99c59f6b Spring  - introducing Spring security    - added Spring authorization (database & ldap)    - added authentication primitives to provide method security
d157846a Spring  - introducing Spring    - added Spring libraries      - gwt servlets are now using Spring, including the new command pattern    - work in progress... (+ some things may have got broken)
3cc238cf Code cleanup / Maven  - to be compatible with Maven build, Constants.REL_DATE and Constants.BLD_NUMBER are now using ${propertyName} notation (for the build date and number to be inserted)   - also, across all the code, methods getReleaseDate(), getBuildNumber() and getVersion() are now used instead of the attributes REL_DATE and BLD_NUMBER     - they returns ? for the build nuber / date when the properties were not replaced (e.g., if UniTime is deployed directly through MyEclipse)
2831fda3 GWT Events  - all authorization checks moved to a separate class  - added ability to upload a file (e.g., to be attached with the event email)  - Event Detail -- added ability to approve / reject / inquire  - many other small improvements (e.g., session info is hidden while on event pages, page width now considers menu on the side,...)
03a4e0b6 Event Timetable  - added Event Detail dialog
484fd484 Event Timetable  - server part changed to use GWT command pattern  - code cleanup and few small improvements
71dcd731 Event Timetable  - added room filter  - allow to display multiple rooms at once or one room at a time  - iCalendar export considers event and room filter, and selection of room(s) and week(s)  - other small improvements
9d448645 Event Timetable  - time grid: size (width) of boxes corresponds with the number meetings there is    - for room and personal timetable, boxes are also moved into individual weeks  - added event filter
eb26e89c Event Timetable  - iCalendar export: do not check for authentication (security is done by calendar query encoding)    - this fixes the problem with the exported calendar being empty
5b0d86f6 Calendar servlet: URL encription changed to AES-128  - was AES-256, however that requires Java(TM) Cryptography Extension (JCE) Unlimited Strength Jurisdiction Policy Files that may not always be installed
990b5a7c Online Student Sectioning: Student Notification Emails  - include timetable in the iCalendar format  - include timetable grid as a PNG (to ensure it is displayed properly by an email client)
5cc2039c Online Student Sectioning -- merge student sectioning changes from the development (dev_sectioning branch) to the trunk
2b9c4a2a Calendar exports - if parameter encryption fails, fall back to no encryption
f8c00c54 Event Timetable -- export to calendar  - avoid ArrayIndexOutOfBounds exception when there are two or more instructors with empty emails    - "||".split("\\|") does not return an array with two empty strings as expected, but just one empty string    - no email expressed by "-" (dash), instead of "" (empty string)
39f3c5ab Ensure that the exported calendar is in UTF-8.
1ccb9788 UniTime 3.1 moved to branch maint_UniTime31 UniTime 3.2 merged from dev_curricula back to main branch (HEAD)

content.content:
4ca7fd19 iCalendar Exports
268f055c Event Export: iCalendar
592152de Technology update
57614e70 Events: Time Grid (course title) - added ability to display course title in the header of an event in the time grid - this only happens when the application property unitime.events.grid_display_title is set to true   (defaults to false, current behaviour) - only applies to class events (course related events and examination events can relate to multiple courses and can have multiple titles with ambiguous choice which one to display) - when multiple course title exists, only the first one is displayed   (e.g., in the case of a cross-list, it should be the title of the controlling course) - format: course title (instruction section) - example: Fundamentals of Biology II (Laboratory 12038-042)
7e1b3601 License and version changes
0b3d1d9f Event Management: iCalendar Export  - fixed SEQUENCE and DTSTAMP attributes in the iCalendar feed    - this change fixes the issue of DTSTAMP being blank in certain cases (and violating the RFC 5545)
8359c9fa iCalendar Export  - create ICS files using Biweekly iCalendar library  - start/end times are exported in the current (server) time zone, with the appropriate time zone identification  - better handling of events with multiple meetings on a particular day  - this is to increase compatibility of UniTime ICS files (especially with Google Calendar)
ea4acc83 Events: iCalendar Export  - If there is a meeting with multiple locations, escape the comma that separates these meetings to avoid calendar software to misinterpret it    (e.g., LOCATION:EDUC 101\, EDUC 102)
8d4120c5 Code cleanup  - using svn blame to define (or extend) @author tags    - in case of multiple authors, the authors are ordered by their contribution (most contributing authors first)  - include 2013 and UniTime version 3.5 in the copyright message
ff1f73a1 Events: Export  - fixed the export when a column is ordered in a descendant order (from last to first)  - this fixes the array index out of bounds exception that was thrown as the sort option was not parsed properly in this case (e.g., -8 indicates 9th column in the descendant order)
864fb803 Events: Export to iCalendar  - skip cancelled and rejected meetings
0a17f6c0 Merge of recent changes from dev_events branch to trunk:
d157846a Spring  - introducing Spring    - added Spring libraries      - gwt servlets are now using Spring, including the new command pattern    - work in progress... (+ some things may have got broken)
7e9b3ea8 GWT Events  - iCalendar export    - added ability to export iCalendar with all meetings marked as CANCELLED (when an event is deleted / rejected)    - export meetings using RRULE rather then RDATE (RDATE does not seem to work well in Apple's iCal)  - all exports    - include user id in the encoded export URL (to be able to export My Events, etc.)  - Add/Edit Event    - event managers can use standard notes    - Add Meetings: fixed scrolling issue in FireFox (when there are many days selected), show hints  - Academic Session selection   - show first and last event date of the selected session as a hint - Events/Meetings   - alignment of Capacity column header moved to right
3cc238cf Code cleanup / Maven  - to be compatible with Maven build, Constants.REL_DATE and Constants.BLD_NUMBER are now using ${propertyName} notation (for the build date and number to be inserted)   - also, across all the code, methods getReleaseDate(), getBuildNumber() and getVersion() are now used instead of the attributes REL_DATE and BLD_NUMBER     - they returns ? for the build nuber / date when the properties were not replaced (e.g., if UniTime is deployed directly through MyEclipse)
8fea7d86 GWT Events  - Subject, Personal, Curriculum, Department timetable: include arrange hours classes  - changed menu to use the new GWT-based event pages  - fixed sorting on exported PDFs  - added ability to return meetings with no location (classes / exams with no room)  - added ability to change academic session while creating a new event  - few other improvements
a4c26f4c GWT Events  - added ability to export to PDF    - export to CSV/PDF also takes the column selection and sorting into account  - many small improvements

content.content:
9864c1a9 Events: Confirmation Emails  - format event confirmation emails using a template (using FreeMaker)
05787768 Event Email  - for additional emails with no @: add default suffix from the unitime.email.event.suffix application property (e.g., @unitime.org)
5362ff9f Event Email  - use the same color coding for approval status as on the Events page (e.g., pending status is in red)
16986bdd Events  - meetings that will expire (pending, not in the past, with an event that has the expiration date set): display approval status "expire <date>" instead of "pending" (<date> is the expiration date of the event)
16421524 Events  - added ability to set expiration date on the event  - requires Event Set Expiration permission  - when an event expires (shortly after midnight the next day), all pending meeting are cancelled  - some more testing of the expiration process is needed
4ceb871b Event Management: Emails  - always set the reply-to field by the user who is initiated the event change
f1d9e8a3 Event Management  - added ability to disable sending email confirmation for a particular action (add / edit / delete / approve / inquire / cancel / reject event)    - manager users only (users with EventLookupContact permission)    - there is a toggle next to create / update / .. button    - default can be set in user settings, unitime.email.confirm.default property, values true or false, defaults to true (send confirmation)
f8603a02 Edit Event  - added ability to modify an existing meeting (or meetings)    - to modify a meeting, click on a (pending or approved) meeting or select one or more meetings (with the same start and end time) and use the "Modify..." action    - the same dialog as with adding new meetings is used, but the information from the selected meeting (or meetings) is used to populate all the fields (including the room selection on the next page)    - when a different start/end time, date(s), or room(s) are selected a new meeting (or meetings) is created and the old meeting is deleted or cancelled (if it cannot be deleted)      - the status of the new meeting is pending regardless the status of the old meeting    - only meetings that can be deleted and/or cancelled can be modified as the operation always results in deleting / canceling the old meetings and creating new meetings
ab1ff3ff Edit Event  - cancel operation got corrected  - better distinguish between delete and cancel operations if done through the event edit page
4e2dd9bc Events  - added ability to cancel a meeting  - cancelled and rejected meetings are kept in the database    - approvedDate on the meeting changed to approvalDate with a new approvalStatus column added    - approval status now contains: pending (requested meeting), approved, cancelled, and rejected    - approval date contains the date of the last approval / cancellation / rejection action  - following workflow changes has been made:   - only pending meetings (requested but not yet approved meetings) can be deleted   - both pending and approved meetings can be cancelled (by the requester or an event manager)   - approved meeting can be only cancelled (by an event manager), it cannot be rejected   - cancelled and rejected meetings cannot be changed - it is possible to disable the delete by removing the Event Meeting Delete permission   - this would mean that a meeting (of a special, unavailability, or a course related event) never gets deleted (it can only be cancelled, approved, or rejected)
17349f2d UniTime Email  - added ability to provide custom implementation of sending mail from UniTime
0a17f6c0 Merge of recent changes from dev_events branch to trunk:
f9311179 GWT Events  - Event Filter    - add Not Approved events mode    - Awaiting Events, Awaiting My Approval do not include past meetings    - added ability to include (special) events from other sessions (All Sessions toggle)      - outside of the session events are only visible on List of Events and List of Meetings and they cannot be approved, rejected, or edited      - date, time, location, and approval is displayed in gray (like in past events)    - Empty filter was not remembered (refresh did reset the filter back to "My Events")  - Approval   - can approve right corrected (event manager must manage the room to be able to approve / reject)   - List of Events / Meetings no longer allows approve / reject / inquire all (with no selection)  - Event Edit   - new meetings that are going to be approved are marked "new approval"   - deleted meetings are visible, but marked as "deleted meeting"   - fixed a conflicting problem when a new meeting is overlapping with a deleted one   - add event: time & room selection was not properly reset  - merged from dev_events, revision 3116
99c59f6b Spring  - introducing Spring security    - added Spring authorization (database & ldap)    - added authentication primitives to provide method security
d157846a Spring  - introducing Spring    - added Spring libraries      - gwt servlets are now using Spring, including the new command pattern    - work in progress... (+ some things may have got broken)
7e9b3ea8 GWT Events  - iCalendar export    - added ability to export iCalendar with all meetings marked as CANCELLED (when an event is deleted / rejected)    - export meetings using RRULE rather then RDATE (RDATE does not seem to work well in Apple's iCal)  - all exports    - include user id in the encoded export URL (to be able to export My Events, etc.)  - Add/Edit Event    - event managers can use standard notes    - Add Meetings: fixed scrolling issue in FireFox (when there are many days selected), show hints  - Academic Session selection   - show first and last event date of the selected session as a hint - Events/Meetings   - alignment of Capacity column header moved to right
3cc238cf Code cleanup / Maven  - to be compatible with Maven build, Constants.REL_DATE and Constants.BLD_NUMBER are now using ${propertyName} notation (for the build date and number to be inserted)   - also, across all the code, methods getReleaseDate(), getBuildNumber() and getVersion() are now used instead of the attributes REL_DATE and BLD_NUMBER     - they returns ? for the build nuber / date when the properties were not replaced (e.g., if UniTime is deployed directly through MyEclipse)
9d442044 GWT Events  - added ability to export to PDF    - export to CSV/PDF also takes the column selection and sorting into account  - many small improvements
41ddc1ba GWT Events  - code cleanup: very similar tables List of Events, List of Meetings, and Meetings (event detail/edit) merged together into one class  - many small improvements
f6759361 GWT Events  - new email notification (using the same style as in student enrollment emails)

content.text:
This confirms exactly the pre-fix code shown in the bug-fixing diff. All five `Biweekly.write(ical).go()` call sites (matching the "before" side of the fix diff) were added in this single commit.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 8359c9faaa074a4bbcdc677971a42ae17133356a

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** The fix commit (4ca7fd19) replaces `Biweekly.write(ical).go(...)` calls with an `ICalWriter` that explicitly sets `writer.getTimezoneInfo().setDefaultTimeZone(TimeZone.getDefault())` in four files: `EventEmail.java`, `EventsExportEventsToICal.java`, `CalendarServlet.java`, and `CalendarExport.java`. I ran `git log --follow` on each of these four files to trace their history and find where the `Biweekly.write(...).go(...)` pattern originated.

**(2) Root cause commit:** All four file histories converge on commit `8359c9fa` ("iCalendar Export - create ICS files using Biweekly iCalendar library ... start/end times are exported in the current (server) time zone, with the appropriate time zone identification"). This commit introduced the Biweekly library itself (adding the jars, `pom.xml`/classpath changes) and added the exact `Biweekly.write(ical).go()` call sites later replaced by the fix — matching line-for-line with the "before" side of the bug-fix diff in all four files.

**(3) Evidence:** 
- `git show 8359c9fa --stat` shows it added `biweekly-0.3.3.jar` and modified exactly these same four Java files (plus two unrelated ones).
- Grepping the diff of `8359c9fa` for `Biweekly.write` shows it adding:
  - `CalendarServlet.java`: `Biweekly.write(ical).go(out);`
  - `EventEmail.java`: `return (exp ? Biweekly.write(ical).go() : null);`
  - `EventsExportEventsToICal.java`: `Biweekly.write(ical).go(helper.getWriter());`
  - `CalendarExport.java`: two occurrences of `return Biweekly.write(ical).go();`
  
  These are precisely the lines removed in the bug-fixing commit's diff (the `-` lines), and no default timezone was ever set on the `Biweekly.write()` builder in this commit or afterward — until the fix. Since the commit's own message claims dates were exported "in the current (server) time zone," but the Biweekly library's default writer does not attach a `TZID`/local timezone context (relying on floating/UTC-ish handling internally), this is consistent with the described DST bug: exported dates would not properly reflect DST transitions for the local timezone.

I'm confident this is the introducing commit — it is the sole commit across all four files' full histories that introduces the flawed `Biweekly.write(ical).go()` API usage without timezone configuration, and it is directly reverted/corrected by the fix commit.
